summary: The patch caches the merged map returned by FilteringMetricRegistry#getMetrics in a volatile field. It clears the cache on register, remove and when a metric is added to the excluded map. This matches CASSSIDECAR-347 and adds the CHANGES.txt entry under 0.3.0. Risks: the invalidation for excluded metrics runs before the metric is inserted, so a concurrent getMetrics() can cache a stale map that omits the new metric until the next change. The patch also includes an unrelated PeriodicTaskExecutor hashCode change that the ticket does not mention. No security surface touched. PR description is a bare 'Patch by ... reviewed by TBD' line, but the ticket is clear.

findings.title: Invalidate the cached map after the excluded metric is inserted, not before
findings.rule: CASSSIDECAR-347: cache must be recomputed whenever the registry changes; the ticket's concurrency test plan
findings.problem: addExcludedMetricIfNotExists nulls allMetrics inside the computeIfAbsent mapping function, so the null is set before the entry is in excludedMetrics. A concurrent getMetrics() can take the lock after the invalidation, iterate excludedMetrics (a ConcurrentHashMap iteration does not see the in-flight insert), and store a snapshot that lacks the new excluded metric. Nothing invalidates it again, so getMetrics() keeps returning the stale map until the next register or remove. The Javadoc says getMetrics exists to prevent re-registering excluded metrics, so a stale map defeats that. The register() path does not have this problem because it invalidates after registration.
findings.fix: Call computeIfAbsent first, and invalidate allMetrics after it returns (only when the metric was newly added, for example by tracking that inside the mapping function). That way a snapshot taken after the invalidation sees the entry.

findings.title: Split the PeriodicTaskKey hashCode caching out of this patch
findings.rule: Scope: unrelated changes mixed into the patch (sidecar standards, Scope)
findings.problem: The patch caches PeriodicTaskKey.hashCode, which is unrelated to FilteringMetricRegistry. CASSSIDECAR-347 does not mention it and gives no profiling evidence for it. This is a drive-by optimisation.
findings.fix: Drop the PeriodicTaskExecutor change from this PR, or move it to its own ticket with its own justification.

findings.title: Simplify the double-checked locking in getMetrics
findings.problem: The reassignment 'allMetrics = existingAllMetrics = Collections.unmodifiableMap(...)' and the else branch that re-reads the field make the method harder to follow. The method also now also performs the initial copy while holding the registry monitor.
findings.fix: Use a local variable for the built map, assign it to the field once, and return it.
